question: Number of countries have higher economic opportunity than the world
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_opportunity_countries FROM global_development_indicators WHERE econ_opportunity_index > (SELECT AVG(econ_opportunity_index) FROM global_development_indicators); LIMIT 50;  ```sql SELECT COUNT(*) as high_opportunity_countries FROM   global_development_indicators WHERE  econ_opportunity_index > (SELECT AVG(econ_opportunity_index) FROM global_development_indicators); LIMIT   50; ```
